content.short: Mysterium Network is an open-source decentralized VPN and privacy tools suite.
content.description: Mysterium Network is a free-to-participate network of nodes that host protocols, tools, and essential decentralized infrastructure to resist internet censorship. Participants can contribute by running nodes in their chosen locations, expanding the network’s coverage and reinforcing its resilience against node failures, service disruptions, and attempts to block access. By distributing nodes across diverse regions, the network seeks to maintain open connectivity and robust operation even under adverse conditions.
